designation: IN THE COURT OF ADDITIONAL SESSIONS JUDGE
jurisdictionNote: District-level criminal courts in Delhi across six court complexes: Saket, Patiala House, Tis Hazari, Karkardooma, Rohini, and Dwarka. Sessions courts try offences punishable with imprisonment exceeding 7 years.

party_designation.state: State (NCT of Delhi) through S.H.O., P.S. {policeStation}

verification_format:
I, {deponent_name}, {designation}, do hereby verify that the contents of the above application are true and correct to my knowledge. No part of it is false and nothing material has been concealed therefrom.

Verified at {place} on this {date}.

DEPONENT
localRules: Bail applications under S.483 BNSS must mention whether bail was earlier rejected by the Magistrate.
Anticipatory bail applications must be accompanied by an affidavit.
Certified copy of FIR and remand order to be annexed.
If bail was previously rejected, mention the changed circumstances warranting fresh application.
E-filing is available — hard copies to be filed within stipulated time.
Court fee stamp of appropriate denomination to be affixed.
